events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years On
events.blurb: This date marks 30 years since the tragic shooting of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Thirty years since we lost him, Tupac Shakur's music and legacy continue to resonate. What's your go-to track from the West Coast icon?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The anniversary of the death of rock guitar legend Jimi Hendrix.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Still inspiring guitarists worldwide, Jimi Hendrix's impact is undeniable. What's the one riff that always blows your mind?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That cover, those tracks... pure genius. What's your favourite moment from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude shaped a generation. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Liam Gallagher, still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis anthem he sang?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless album 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates globally. What does this track mean to you?

events.title: The First iPod: 25 Years On
events.blurb: Apple launched the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember click wheels and tiny screens? Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod changed how we carried our tunes. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to legendary theme tunes, what's your ultimate 007 moment? Licence to thrill, indeed.

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Sending a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon. What's your favourite sketch?

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years of The White Album! The Beatles' most eclectic work. Which track from this double LP is your unexpected favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The anniversary of the death of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Gone but never forgotten. Today marks the anniversary of losing the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed pop music forward. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: The anniversary of the tragic death of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Message
angles.copy: On this poignant anniversary, we reflect on the life and enduring message of John Lennon. His music continues to inspire peace and understanding.
